name: Oceanside Welding & Fabrication
old_description: Precision aluminum railings, gates, and fencing for homes and businesses.
about:
Oceanside Welding & Fabrication operates from Oakland Park, Florida, serving Broward and Palm Beach counties. The company was founded by Jerry Menagh, who built the business on years of hands-on welding and aluminum fabrication experience. What began as a small local operation has grown into a family-owned shop known for structural aluminum work across South Florida.

The shop specializes in custom aluminum railings, gates, and fencing for residential and commercial properties, along with lanai column repair, trailer fabrication, and general metal fabrication in aluminum, stainless steel, and mild steel. Work is performed both in-house at their 4340 NE 5th Terrace facility and via mobile welding units. CNC plasma cutting capability is slated to come online soon. Projects run from design through cutting, welding, and installation, with powder coating coordinated as needed.

Customers include homeowners, builders, and property managers throughout South Florida. The company also builds custom trailers for pressure-washing, landscaping, and recreational use. Marine repairs such as pontoon welding have been performed, though the core focus remains architectural and structural aluminum for coastal environments.

Menagh started the business on the principle of doing the job right with pride. The company emphasizes clean welds, corrosion-resistant materials, transparent quoting, and dependable timelines. Its stated values—craftsmanship, integrity, reliability, safety, and community—guide a model that combines in-shop precision with on-site mobility.
